children: Brazil’s top electoral court suspended presidential candidate Renan Santos’s digital campaign and froze R$3.3 million in public funds after he became the only contender to publicly back a national Bitcoin reserve. According to BeInCrypto, Justice Dias Toffoli also barred Santos and running mate Aroldo Medina from debates, blocked paid ads on 16 social media profiles and halted new disbursements from the FEFC. Santos called the ruling censorship and said he would seek an injunction.

title: Brazil Suspends Renan Santos Campaign Over Bitcoin Reserve Pledge
